card.name: Sequencing words before a permitted next step
card.fires_on: Linking words like before, but, then, afterwards or a comma that follow a first condition or step and introduce what may or can happen next. The next clause is usually a permission or later step.

modes.label: Order of steps
modes.description: Words like before, then, afterwards or after that mark what comes after a first required step.
modes.example: You must first teach human cognitive, visual and mechanical skills<< before>> introducing any mechanical device

modes.label: But-then permission
modes.description: A but or comma after a restriction leads into what may still be done.
modes.example: Contact lenses should be removed during instillation of brinzolamide ophthalmic suspension 1%,<< but>> may be reinserted 15

modes.label: Condition met, then allowed
modes.description: A comma after a completed condition leads into what a person may then do.
modes.example: Initiate therapy in a healthcare setting and once therapy has been safely established<<,>> the healthcare provider may determine whether self-admin

card.writes: It favors words meaning "can" or "only then can" and suppresses "must" words, so the text goes on to a permitted option.
card.plain: It marks the point after a first step or restriction where the text goes on to say what may be done next.
